title: Layer Composition Canvas
objective: Implement the bounded interactive layer-composition behavior over sealed SAA-01 project/layer identity and SAA-02 page/panel layout grammar: position, scale, crop, rotate, flip, z-order, opacity, lock/hide and clipping with keyboard/non-drag alternatives, without taking ARI/source-domain truth or later asset-palette/actor/export authority.
acceptance: Layer position, scale, rotation, flip, opacity and z-order edits are deterministic authoring state over stable SAA-01 layer identity.
Crop and clipping operations are reversible presentation state and do not mutate source resource bytes.
Lock/hide state is explicit, deterministic and preserved across save/restore.
Keyboard/non-drag alternatives can perform every blocking composition transform required by the canvas.
Pointer/touch manipulation and keyboard manipulation resolve to the same canonical SAA authoring commands.
Composition commands respect SAA-02 panel/frame bounds and preserve explicit reading order unless the user explicitly edits reading order through its owner.
Undoable composition operations expose stable command identity suitable for later SAA-13 history/versioning without implementing SAA-13 itself.
ARI/source resources remain references; composition creates no parallel asset library or source-domain mutation authority.
Provider-off local operation is supported; optional AI and paid cloud are not required.
SAA-04+ asset palette, actor projection, export/share/publication and SMB10B final Creator integration remain unauthorized.
boundaries: SAA-01.1 project/page/panel/layer identity and SAA-02.1 layout grammar remain sealed.
SAA-03 owns interactive composition transforms only; SAA-04 owns searchable ARI asset-palette/capability filtering.
Transforms, crop, clipping, opacity, lock/hide and z-order are presentation/authoring state and cannot mutate source asset bytes or Character/Scene truth.
Accessibility requires keyboard/non-drag equivalents for blocking canvas actions.
No export/share/publication or final Creator integration authority is granted.
No SAA-04 implementation authority is granted by selection.
next_action: SAA-03 is completed_verified. SAA-04 — ARI Asset Palette & Capability Filtering — is selected_not_started without implementation authority.
